question:
Choose the best one-word substitute for:

"An inscription written on stone in the memory of a deceased person."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Epitaph**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Epigraph"** refers to an inscription or short quote at the beginning of a book, chapter, or document that suggests its theme. (शिलालेख या लेख)

 
 
• **Example:** The epigraph at the beginning of the novel set the tone for the entire story.
 
 

 
• **"Epitaph"** is a short text written on a tombstone or plaque in memory of the deceased. It often honors and commemorates the individual. (समाधिलेख)

 
 
• **Example:** The epitaph on his tombstone read, "Here lies a man who loved and was loved."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Epitaph**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Epigraph** (शिलालेख): An inscription on a building, statue, or coin, or a quote at the beginning of a text suggesting its theme.

 
 
• **Example:** The epigraph on the wall was a dedication to the founders of the institution.
 
 

 
• **Memoir** (संस्मरण): A written account of someone's personal experiences.

 
 
• **Example:** She published a memoir detailing her years as an artist in Paris.
 
 

 
• **Autograph** (हस्ताक्षर): A person's signature, especially that of a celebrity.

 
 
• **Example:** The fan waited for hours to get the singer's autograph on her poster.
